title: Longer trips, charging, and road-test mentions
summary: This topic combines comments about longer-trip suitability and charging guidance with a few unrelated road-test and feature-availability mentions, so the cluster is only loosely coherent.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car works well for longer highway trips and that certain features or charging practices are helpful when maximum range is needed.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention concern that EV range may be limiting on longer trips and include a separate service-style note about faults being cleared and the vehicle road tested.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention longer trips, charging to full for extra range, missing features, road feel changes, and brief road-test or noise notes without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a sentiment-specific reading of the topic.
The cluster mixes at least two subjects—longer-trip use and charging, plus unrelated service or feature-removal remarks—so it should not be treated as a single clean theme.
Some fragments are very short or ambiguous, leaving too little context to tell whether the reviewer is praising, criticizing, or simply describing usage.
